_comment: The scored corpora the evals replay. Read by evals/corpus.py; see that
module for why a manifest exists at all (the glob replayed 49 files back to
2026-05-31, so completeness and reproducibility could never go green).
Derived on 2026-08-12, not chosen: for every Place Key currently in the
live base, the newest scored file by mtime that contains it. That is 14 of
the 49 files and covers 476 of the base's 493 keyed records. A file that is
nobody's newest source only contributes superseded rows.
Adding a batch is a one-line edit here. Removing one is a claim that no
lead in the base still comes from it — re-derive rather than assume.
scored_rescore_claimfix.csv is deliberately absent: it was superseded by
the _reverdict_2026-08-12 refresh, which is what was uploaded. Keeping both
would replay every claimfix lead twice, once under a withdrawn verdict.
